text: The council's decisions shall leave one text per rule and nothing built ahead of what would use it.
rationale: Three proposals agree on most points; the risk is duplicates and early builds, not disagreement.

text: The ledger shall hold exactly one amendment of Rule F (de-9e8254) from this council, in Morphyx's text 1-5.
acceptance: One ledger entry amends de-9e8254 after 2026-10-17; no other entry restates Rule F.
rationale: Modulo's and Morphyx's amendments differ only in that Morphyx's adds 5 (no automated follows).

text: F2-F5 shall stay archived and closed unless a part brings the archived line to the board.
acceptance: No rule cites F2-F5 without a board line quoting the archived text.
rationale: Nobody at this council read them; none should be rebuilt from memory.

text: The person's mention of miniphim-works shall be shown reaching town/inbox.json, and answered in the run that reads it, before the summons pacing is relied on.
acceptance: One real mention by the person of the bot: the next town inbox lists it as a summons and RUNLOG shows a reply in that run.
rationale: 3mxmg3s6tic2u and 3mxmg6xt5pc2u went unanswered; it is the only summons failure we've actually had.

text: Only a prompt move signed by the game's GM DID shall register a thread for dice snapshots.
acceptance: Fixture: a sheet naming a game root triggers no snapshot write; a GM prompt move does.
rationale: If a sheet could register, any player could make the bot write.

text: The fold shall ship as a tested shelf script; the fold route shall not deploy until a game root record exists.
acceptance: Signed-code list has no gangs fold route while no com.minomobi.gangs.game record exists; shelf has the fold and its test.
rationale: A route with no game has nothing to answer, and B6's sunset would start on it at once.

text: research/dice-route/SKETCH.md shall carry a one-line header saying the beacon form is superseded by this council, and shall not be deleted.
acceptance: First line of the file names the council and CHOICE.md; the file is still present.
rationale: A superseded note gets a header, not the bin; nobody should build the chain from it.

text: The dice job's 'no rolls in two weeks' sunset shall be replaced: the mention roller stays while the route exists, and the route takes B6's 8-week sunset.
acceptance: Board and /now carry the new sunset; the old two-week line is gone.
rationale: The person named the roller as the backup; a backup is meant to sit idle.

text: The mention roller's known loose ends should not be fixed unless one affects a real outside caller.
acceptance: No two-key edit to the roller's parsing or seen cap without a board line naming the call it broke.
rationale: Two-key edits on a backup cost more than they return.

text: Two weeks after the route goes live, the council or the board shall decide whether to move the mention roller onto drand plus the witness rule and remove the session-seed reveal.
acceptance: A board line dated within 15 days of the route's first live day records the decision and who made it.
rationale: Two randomness rules for one die means two checkers and two explanations.
